transcript: Speaker A: Ainda kabhi mere colleagues ke saamne munh mat kholna. Kya jarurat thi shauk se English bolne ki unke saamne? Jab bolna nahi aata toh chup raha karo na. [Never open your mouth in front of my colleagues again. What was the need to show off speaking English in front of them? When you don't know how to speak, just keep quiet.] Speaker B: Us din itni beijjati hui ki maine thaan liya ki English toh main seekh ke rahungi. Saath mein bolne ke liye koi tha nahi, toh PW Talk app use karna shuru kiya. Isme hazaaron video lessons aur practice questions the. Reels ki jagah yeh dekhti thi. Bilkul game jaisa tha toh boring bhi nahi lagta tha. Isme ek AI English teacher hai, Riva. Riva ke saath English bolne ki maine actual practice ki. Yeh AI hai toh meri galtiyon par na judge karti thi na chillati thi, balki correct kar deti thi. Kaam ke beech bas 10 se 15 minute baat karti thi Riva se. Usi mein usne mujhe har tarah ke actual real-life scenarios mein kaise English bolna hai, yeh sikha diya. Ab mujhe kisi ke bhi taane aur insult sunne ki jarurat nahi hai. I can take a stand for myself. [That day I felt so insulted that I resolved to learn English. There was no one to practice speaking with, so I started using the PW Talk app. It had thousands of video lessons and practice questions. I watched this instead of Reels. It was just like a game, so it didn't feel boring. It has an AI English teacher, Riva. I did actual practice speaking English with Riva. Since it's AI, she neither judged nor yelled at my mistakes, but corrected them. I would talk to Riva for just 10 to 15 minutes between work. In that time, she taught me how to speak English in all kinds of actual real-life scenarios. Now I don't need to listen to anyone's taunts and insults. I can take a stand for myself.]

summary: After being humiliated by her husband for her poor English, a woman decides to improve her skills using the PW Talk app. She practices daily with Riva, an AI English teacher who corrects her mistakes without judgment. Through interactive lessons, she gains the confidence to speak English fluently in real-life situations.
